name: ModelVariant842_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant842_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (three bolts leave a model point at their own start times and fly towards a jittered point on the opposing slot, wrapped in a ring of quartered sprites and spinning Gouraud strips and trailing a ribbon and smoke puffs; on arrival each flares into a quartered glow with a fan of growing textured rays and animated sparks while the ambient green and blue dim and recover); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolts and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 once each when the first and second bolts arrive, 1 once when the last bolt arrives, 2 once the ambient has recovered and the last glow has faded and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-859 and 956 images build it from the same source through french_model_variant/variant859_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
